scope: Build a local OCI artifact from a digest-pinned public base, verify manifest-to-attestation descriptor linkage and read the resolved base reported by BuildKit. A second synthetic case verifies trusted-key DSSE, subject digest binding and an exact approved base allowlist. No image is published. This case covers local build evidence and the verification mechanism. Production builder identities, provenance ingestion and runtime admission integration require their own checks.

checks.claim: BuildKit links a real local artifact to the exact approved base material
final OCI metadata alone cannot establish an approved base image

observed.claim: exact final artifact identity is established; base lineage is not

checks.claim: unlisted changed final image digest is rejected by exact final-image allowlist
final image digest and self-asserted history cannot replace authenticated provenance

observed.observed: provenance signature invalid or signer key id untrusted

checks.claim: Authentic provenance is rejected when presented for a different image digest

observed.observed: provenance subject does not bind the final image digest

checks.claim: trusted signed provenance binds the final image to the approved base digest
validly signed provenance naming an unapproved base is denied

observed.observed: base image digest is not in the approved base digest allowlist

checks.claim: altered provenance payload is denied before trusting its base claim

observed.observed: provenance signature invalid or signer key id untrusted

checks.claim: permitted final image with approved authenticated base remains allowed
